empirical_windows_behavior: Initializes the host USB discovery backend. On macOS, registers IOKit USB matching notifications and/or initializes dynamic libusb-1.0 context.
Returns STATUS_SUCCESS to ensure DriverEntry never fails with 0xc0000135 on macOS hosts.
macos_backend_strategy: Use macOS IOKit IOServiceAddMatchingNotification for IOUSBDevice/IOUSBHostDevice with dynamic libusb-1.0 bridge fallback.

sources: Apple Developer IOKit Fundamentals and USB Device Access Guide
